title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Xcubated Business Solutions (XBS) is a global consulting and technology firm formed by seasoned professionals with multi-industry and multi-cultural experience. The company partners with organizations to deliver future-proof advisory services, digital transformation solutions, and next-generation innovations. XBS provides strategic consulting in management, IT strategy, business process improvement, and smart city initiatives, alongside building digital platforms, mobile applications, and automation solutions. Through its Global Delivery Centre, XBS supports clients with setup, operations management, governance, and training, while also driving innovation in areas such as AI, machine learning, cyber security automation, and immersive technologies. The XBS Fusion program further offers business mentorship, go-to-market collaboration, investment assistance, and cloud infrastructure services to help clients scale sustainably.

* **Role Description**

**Experience**
: 4–7 years

**Technical Skills:**
Playwright, Newman,SQL, Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, Azure Service Bus Explorer, Storage Explorer and Azure DevOps.

**Responsibilities:**
Build automated UI/API tests, manage test data, expand regression coverage, report defects and coordinate with Core QA.

**Requirements**

:

* Strong written and spoken English communication
* Understanding of business processes and requirements
* Experience with UK/European clients preferred
* Facilities Management, Property, Field Services or ERP domain experience desirable
* Ability to work with UK business hours
* Strong collaboration, ownership and problem-solving skills

title: Automation Engineer
description:
One of our clients is looking for a talented and result-oriented
**Automation Engineer / Senior Automation Engineer**
to design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that ensure software quality and reliability.

📍
**Location:**
Tamil Nadu / Kerala

💰
**Salary:**
₹9 LPA – ₹15 LPA

Experience:
**3–7 years**

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium with Java or C#.
* Build and enhance reusable automation frameworks and test utilities.
* Execute functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Collaborate with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define test scenarios.
* Identify, log, track, and verify software defects.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing.
* Analyze test results and prepare detailed execution reports.
* Follow automation best practices, coding standards, and software quality processes.
* Provide technical guidance and mentor junior team members, where applicable.

Mandatory Skills

* Selenium
* Java or C#
* Test Automation

Good to Have

* BDD frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow
* API Testing
* Agile methodologies
* CI/CD pipelines
* Software Quality Assurance
* Defect Tracking

Experience

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in test automation.
* Hands-on experience with Selenium using Java or C#.
* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in an Agile development environment.

Suitable Designations

* Automation Engineer
* Senior Automation Engineer
* Test Automation Engineer
* QA Automation Engineer
* Software Test Engineer
* Automation Test Developer

title: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant
description:
🚀
**We're Hiring: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant**

📍 Infopark Thrissur, Koratty | 🕒 Full-Time | 💼 5+ Years Experience

Are you an Odoo expert who enjoys designing solutions, not just building them? We're looking for a
**Senior Odoo Technical Consultant**
to lead the design, development, integration and deployment of enterprise-grade Odoo ERP solutions, and to guide a growing development team.

**What you'll do**

🔹 Design scalable, secure and upgrade-friendly Odoo solutions

🔹 Develop and customise modules, workflows, reports and dashboards

🔹 Build REST API integrations with HRMS, Payroll, CRM, banking, payment gateway and e-commerce platforms

🔹 Lead technical workstreams, run code reviews and mentor junior developers

🔹 Manage deployments, version upgrades, migrations and performance tuning

🔹 Take part in client workshops and technical discussions

**What we're looking for**

✅ 5+ years of hands-on Odoo development and technical consulting

✅ Multiple end-to-end Odoo implementations

✅ Advanced Python and strong PostgreSQL skills

✅ Deep knowledge of the Odoo framework, ORM, security, automated actions and scheduled jobs

✅ Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML and Git

✅ Working knowledge of Linux, plus exposure to Azure, AWS or Docker

✅ Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Software Engineering, Computer Applications or a related field

**Nice to have**

⭐ Odoo Technical Certification

⭐ Experience with Odoo 16, 17 or newer

⭐ Kubernetes, CI/CD and DevOps practices

⭐ Multi-company or multi-country Odoo environments

If you're ready to own the technical side of ERP implementations, we'd like to hear from you.
